name: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
description: The agent's own output is used to manipulate the human in the loop — misleading summaries at approval points, false confidence or impersonation of a trusted source — so a person authorises an unsafe action.
differs: The technique that manufactures human consent; the reporting-integrity attributes describe what the agent's account of the action omitted.
